svg.title: triceratops-briggsdale-491005 - original atlas schematic
svg.desc: Original educational schematic; not a photograph or exact reconstruction. Original generalized horned ceratopsid schematic with a solid frill, not the Briggsdale specimen, a measured pose, skin pattern or a diagnostic T. horridus reconstruction. The Late Maastrichtian age envelope ends at 66 Ma but does not establish presence at exactly 66 Ma.
